sentences.text: The petitioner prays for a writ of mandamus commanding respondent no. 2 to take decision on her application for grant of sale of meat license in her favour.
The petitioner is stated to have filed an application on 3.2.2024.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is unable to explain as to how the respondent no. 2 is Designated Officer (Licensing Authority) under the provision of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. In view of the above, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that in the event the petitioner files proper application before the Designated Officer for grant of license, the said application shall be decided by the Designated Officer (Licensing Authority) strictly, in accordance with law, within a period of twelve weeks from the date of filing of application.

August 27, 2025 Dhirendra/
